title: HtmlMap
responsibility: Renders the native map element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlMap.attributes
inputs.description: Native map attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlMap.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native map element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlMap
outputs.description: The actual native map element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
